model_choice: Direct one-hot assignment with quadratic compactness objective. 4N variables for N sites. Fits CGA GPU annealer for N ≤ 200 (≤800 vars) due to dense QUBO support and linear equality constraints handled by backend penalties.

prep.notes: Filtered AED locations by excluding categories '學校、大型集會場所' and '其他'. Deduplicated by '場所地址' keeping the first occurrence. District filtering (松山、信義、大安、中山) was NOT applied because the '區域代碼' column contains values in the range 63000030-63000110 (prefix '6300' for all rows), which does not allow distinguishing the target districts. All filtered AEDs from the dataset are included. Distance matrix computed via Haversine. Teams are synthetic IDs T1-T4. k=4 as specified.
